jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Responsible for leading all aspects of distribution center operations, including customer service, inventory management, financial performance, operational efficiency, safety, and team member development. Oversees daily warehouse and transportation activities to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective service to stores while maintaining compliance with O’Reilly policies and operational standards. Provides strategic leadership to drive productivity, continuous improvement, accountability, and a high-performance culture throughout the distribution center.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
- Oversee all aspects of distribution center operations, including transportation, shipping, receiving, inventory control, warehouse operations, customer service, physical assets, and inventory integrity.
- Lead daily operational performance to ensure on-time deliveries, shipment accuracy, efficient materials movement, and excellent service levels to stores and customers.
- Direct and manage all distribution center expenses, including labor, operating costs, and capital expenditures, while maintaining alignment with financial objectives and budget expectations.
- Partner with the Regional Director Distribution to develop annual business plans, operational strategies, labor plans, and capital budgets that support company goals.
- Collaborate closely with Human Resources to support recruiting, retention, engagement, corrective action processes, and overall team member relations initiatives when needed.
- Conduct team member evaluations, coaching discussions, development planning, and bench building to support succession planning initiatives.
- Promote and maintain a safe working environment by aggressively managing risk, loss prevention, workplace safety initiatives, and environmental standards.
- Analyze operational metrics, workflow performance, labor utilization, transportation activity, and inventory trends to identify opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency improvements.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow optimization, warehouse layout efficiency, logistics processes, scheduling effectiveness, and overall supply chain performance.
- Support additional operational initiatives, special projects, and other duties as assigned by the Regional DC Director or senior leadership in support of distribution center objectives.

SKILLS/EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
Required:
- Minimum of 6 years of distribution center, logistics, warehouse, or supply chain experience.
- Minimum of 3 years of leadership or management experience within a distribution environment.
- Strong understanding of safety practices, risk management, key performance indicators and regulatory compliance within a distribution environment.
- Ability to develop and manage operational budgets, labor expenses, and capital planning initiatives.
- Experience leading large teams across multiple operational functions and shifts.

Desired:
- Experience utilizing warehouse management systems (WMS), transportation management systems (TMS), or supply chain analytics tools.
- Knowledge of advanced logistics planning and inventory optimization.

jobs.description:

Collaborate with IT leaders to implement and continuously improve Iterative and Agile project management practices that improve project outcomes. Maintain responsibility and accountability for successful delivery of projects that meet organizational goals and deliver business value.

- Lead a team of project managers to ensure successful delivery of IT projects to deliver business value across technology and business functions
- Develop a vision for improving the value created by the Program Management office by transforming and continuously improving services offered and implementing additional services that improve solution delivery
- Collaborate with solution delivery teams and leadership to implement, standardize and improve project management processes across the IT department

Maintain customer base and increase sales volume on assigned accounts. Average 15 calls per day.
Manage accounts as needed to best serve the professional customer and maintain up-to-date records for each account.  Grow business by remaining competitive and maximizing the profit opportunity for that particular market.  Pursue new, prospective accounts with the goal of one to three weekly (unassigned) cold calls.

jobs.title: Director HR Business Partner, Information Technology
jobs.description:
The Director HR Business Partner, Information Technology serves as the strategic HR business partner to the Chief Information Officer and Information Technology leadership team. This role is responsible for developing and executing people strategies that support business growth, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership development, and technology transformation across a global workforce. The Director partners closely with leaders in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and India to ensure talent strategies, organizational capabilities, and team member experiences align with business objectives and local market needs. As a trusted advisor to technology leaders, this position drives workforce initiatives that strengthen leadership capability, enhance organizational performance, and support O'Reilly Auto Parts' continued international growth.

Essential Job Functions
- Serve as the primary HR business partner to the CIO and Information Technology leadership team, providing strategic guidance on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, and talent strategy.
- Develop and execute human resources strategies that support technology priorities, business growth, digital transformation initiatives, and long-term organizational objectives.
- Partner with technology leaders across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and India to deliver people solutions that balance enterprise consistency with local business and market requirements.
- Lead workforce planning, succession planning, and talent management initiatives to ensure the organization has the capabilities necessary to support current and future business needs.
- Advise leaders on organizational design, team structures, role alignment, and change management strategies that improve effectiveness, scalability, and business performance.
- Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to develop strategies that attract, retain, and develop highly skilled technology talent in competitive global markets.
- Leverage workforce analytics and organizational insights to identify trends, assess organizational health, and drive data-informed talent decisions.
- Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, including Compensation, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, and HR Technology, to deliver integrated solutions that support business objectives and team member growth.
- Provide guidance on team member relations matters, policy interpretation, and employment practices while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations across supported regions.
- Lead, develop, and mentor HR team members while building strong partnerships across Human Resources and Information Technology to advance O'Reilly's culture, values, and strategic priorities.

Required Skills, Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant Human Resources Business Partner or HR leadership experience.
- Experience supporting executive leadership teams and influencing strategic business decisions.

jobs.title: Real Estate Development Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager will maintain ownership of each project from site selection through store opening. Provide development budget for site feasibility and update budget based on project findings. They will maintain all formal communications as it pertains to the development schedule and lease obligations. Manage the overall development and construction of each store. Maintain strategic vision towards resource management and provide checks and balances for cost control.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Assist the Expansion Committee by providing solutions, pricing and development feasibility for prospective properties.
Respond to municipality violations for prospective properties prior to project commencement.
Review Geotechnical Reports, Phase 1/2/3, Asbestos Surveys, Lease Documents and provide solutions for conflicts with the intended development. Provide associated pricing and update the development budget.
Build to Suit/New Construction Building Lease Projects; Receive the construction documents from the Design Department. Review the plans for feasibility of construction as well as value engineering opportunities. Review the Lease and Work Letter to understand the specific terms of individual leases. Contact the landlord to discuss the project, terms of the lease and verify the landlord has submitted for all necessary permits.
Place the project onto the R.E. Schedule based on historical data, consultant reports, location, climate and operational strategy.
Once the order has been verified, provide final approval for fabrication.
Assist the design team by securing the necessary surety’s, special inspection documentation and permit applications.
Review preliminary and final construction documents for feasibility of construction and value engineering opportunities.
Negotiate with authorities having jurisdiction (state, city, fire marshals, etc.) for a reasonable scope of work and fee structure.
Track projects throughout due diligence and design phases and make necessary adjustments to the R.E. Schedule. Communicate with the necessary internal departments so they are aware for their budgeting and planning needs.
Issue a tentative schedule to Operations, Inventory Control, Store Installations and National Account Vendors when a project has been scheduled for less than 90 days.
Develop a list of bidders based on general contractor (G.C.) workloads, performance, licensing and geographical location. Once bidders have been qualified, present the bid list to the Manager of RE Development for approval.
Work with the Development Services Team (D.S.T.) to issue R.F.P.’s, notify the appropriate reporting agencies and Operations.
Monitor design changes and oversee the issuance of addenda and proposal requests. Provide associated costs and update the development budget.
Route Final Budget for approval by the RE Development Management Team.
Monitor each project by utilizing the Weekly Field Reports, photos and direct communication with the G.C.’s project manager and superintendent.
Review and approve all construction materials testing reports.
Visit sites, as required, to verify progress and that plans and specifications are being followed. Provide solutions for construction related issues and meet with governing authorities to negotiate code requirements that do not meet our development model.
Coordinate access to the store for the install team with the G.C. or D. M. Verify all utilities are operational.
Work with Legal to resolve easement disputes, lien notices and construction defect cases. Represent the company in all court proceedings related to development.
Be available 24/7 to respond to natural disasters. Arrange emergency response for all security and life safety issues related to disasters.
Any additional duties as assigned.

SKILLS/EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
Bachelor’s degree in real estate management and 5 years’ experience in a construction related position, preferably in the public sector, or comparable related experience
5 years’ experience in corporate real estate with an emphasis on project management, information gathering and reporting
Knowledge of Microsoft Office; including Excel, Word and Power Point. Excellent ability to organize projects
Strong time management with the ability to set clear timelines for task due dates
Strong communication skills with the a bility to communicate effectively within all levels of the organization

jobs.title: Real Estate Development Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager will maintain ownership of each project from site selection through store opening. Provide development budget for site feasibility and update budget based on project findings. They will maintain all formal communications as it pertains to the development schedule and lease obligations. Manage the overall development and construction of each store. Maintain strategic vision towards resource management and provide checks and balances for cost control.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Assist the Expansion Committee by providing solutions, pricing and development feasibility for prospective properties.
Respond to municipality violations for prospective properties prior to project commencement.
Review Geotechnical Reports, Phase 1/2/3, Asbestos Surveys, Lease Documents and provide solutions for conflicts with the intended development. Provide associated pricing and update the development budget.
Build to Suit/New Construction Building Lease Projects; Receive the construction documents from the Design Department. Review the plans for feasibility of construction as well as value engineering opportunities. Review the Lease and Work Letter to understand the specific terms of individual leases. Contact the landlord to discuss the project, terms of the lease and verify the landlord has submitted for all necessary permits.
Place the project onto the R.E. Schedule based on historical data, consultant reports, location, climate and operational strategy.
Once the order has been verified, provide final approval for fabrication.
Assist the design team by securing the necessary surety’s, special inspection documentation and permit applications.
Review preliminary and final construction documents for feasibility of construction and value engineering opportunities.
Negotiate with authorities having jurisdiction (state, city, fire marshals, etc.) for a reasonable scope of work and fee structure.
Track projects throughout due diligence and design phases and make necessary adjustments to the R.E. Schedule. Communicate with the necessary internal departments so they are aware for their budgeting and planning needs.
Issue a tentative schedule to Operations, Inventory Control, Store Installations and National Account Vendors when a project has been scheduled for less than 90 days.
Develop a list of bidders based on general contractor (G.C.) workloads, performance, licensing and geographical location. Once bidders have been qualified, present the bid list to the Manager of RE Development for approval.
Work with the Development Services Team (D.S.T.) to issue R.F.P.’s, notify the appropriate reporting agencies and Operations.
Monitor design changes and oversee the issuance of addenda and proposal requests. Provide associated costs and update the development budget.
Route Final Budget for approval by the RE Development Management Team.
Monitor each project by utilizing the Weekly Field Reports, photos and direct communication with the G.C.’s project manager and superintendent.
Review and approve all construction materials testing reports.
Visit sites, as required, to verify progress and that plans and specifications are being followed. Provide solutions for construction related issues and meet with governing authorities to negotiate code requirements that do not meet our development model.
Coordinate access to the store for the install team with the G.C. or D. M. Verify all utilities are operational.
Work with Legal to resolve easement disputes, lien notices and construction defect cases. Represent the company in all court proceedings related to development.
Be available 24/7 to respond to natural disasters. Arrange emergency response for all security and life safety issues related to disasters.
Any additional duties as assigned.

SKILLS/EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
Bachelor’s degree in real estate management and 5 years’ experience in a construction related position, preferably in the public sector, or comparable related experience
5 years’ experience in corporate real estate with an emphasis on project management, information gathering and reporting
Knowledge of Microsoft Office; including Excel, Word and Power Point. Excellent ability to organize projects
Strong time management with the ability to set clear timelines for task due dates
Strong communication skills with the a bility to communicate effectively within all levels of the organization

Support communications related to learning initiatives, program launches, and updates
